Metadata.title: Secret Santa — online draw, no sign-up
Metadata.description: Set up the group, run the draw and each person sees only who they got, through their own link. No paper slips, no sign-up.

About.title: About AmigoSecreto
About.intro: AmigoSecreto runs your Secret Santa draw online: each person sees only who they got, through their own link. It's free, has no sign-up and is open source.

secret.title: How the secret is kept
secret.p1: The draw runs on the server, not on the organizer's phone. The organizer's screen shows who has already seen their result, but never who got whom.
secret.p2: Each person has a personal link. Whoever joins through the group link keeps that link only on their own phone. When the organizer types the names, the organizer sends the personal links, so in theory they could open other people's links. If the group wants complete secrecy, everyone should join through the group link.

safety.title: How to know it's safe
safety.p1: AmigoSecreto only asks for your name. It never asks for a password, verification code, phone number, ID number, card details or payment. If a page asks for any of that, it isn't AmigoSecreto.
safety.p2: The link comes from someone in your group. If in doubt, ask whoever sent it before opening it.

who.title: Who makes it
who.p1: AmigoSecreto is an independent project, made in Brazil and maintained by {operator}, the people behind QuemLeva.

code.title: Open source
code.p1: The code is open, under the AGPL-3.0 license, and anyone can check how the draw works <repo>on GitHub</repo>.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains, in plain language, what data AmigoSecreto keeps, why and for how long. AmigoSecreto has no sign-up and doesn't sell or share data for advertising.

collect.title: What we keep
collect.p1: The group details the organizer writes: name, exchange day, suggested amount and notes.
collect.p2: Each participant's name, the gift ideas each person writes, the result of the draw and whether the person has opened their link and seen who they got.
collect.p3: A random code for your device, which recognizes you without a sign-up.
collect.p4: To prevent abuse, we log group creation with a scrambled version (hash) of the IP address. This log is deleted within 1 day.

visibility.title: Who sees what
visibility.p1: Anyone with the group link sees the group name, the date, the suggested amount and the names of the people already taking part.
visibility.p2: Through their personal link, each person sees only who they got and that person's gift ideas. Your gift ideas are shown to whoever gets you.
visibility.p3: The organizer link lets you change the group and run the draw, but doesn't show who got whom. Keep that link to yourself.

device.title: On your device
device.p1: Your browser stores the device code, your links (organizer and personal) and the "My groups" list, plus a cookie with the language you chose. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

providers.title: Services we use
providers.p1: Supabase (database, with servers in São Paulo) and Vercel (website hosting). They process data only so AmigoSecreto can work and may keep technical access logs, such as the IP address, under their own policies.

retention.title: How long
retention.p1: Groups are kept while AmigoSecreto is online, so the links keep working. The organizer can delete the group at any time, and you can ask for deletion through the contact below.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: Under Brazil's data protection law (LGPD), you can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or a whole group. Write to the contact below and include the group link.
rights.p2: In the app itself, you can change or delete your gift ideas, and the organizer can remove participants before the draw.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: The data controller is {operator}. If this policy changes, the date at the top is updated.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: By using AmigoSecreto, you agree to these terms.

service.title: The service
service.p1: AmigoSecreto is free and provided as is, with no guarantee that it will always work or be free of errors. It may change or be discontinued; whenever possible, we'll let you know in advance.

content.title: What you write
content.p1: You're responsible for what you write in the group and in the gift ideas. Don't use AmigoSecreto for illegal, offensive or misleading content, or for spam. We may remove groups that break these rules.

links.title: Links
links.p1: Anyone with the group link can see the participants and join before the draw. The personal link shows one person's result: don't pass yours on. Don't share the organizer link.

payments.title: Gifts and payments
payments.p1: AmigoSecreto doesn't sell, receive or broker gifts or payments. The suggested amount is just an agreement among you.

license.title: Open source
license.p1: AmigoSecreto's code is under the AGPL-3.0 license.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil.

Install.title: Add to home screen
Install.intro: AmigoSecreto then sits with your other apps and opens straight to your groups, no link to find.
Install.ios1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow pointing up) in Safari's toolbar.
Install.ios2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
Install.ios3: Tap "Add". The AmigoSecreto icon shows up on your home screen.
Install.menu1: Open the browser menu (the three dots ⋮).
Install.menu2: Tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app" and confirm.
